current_evidence: The council's 'National and Local Validation' page (last updated 7 March 2024) says the local validation requirements list was approved on 6 March 2023. It links the detailed list (DOCX) and Grokbot's PDF as the 'Quick Checklist to be read in conjunction with Local Validation List'. No newer list or post-2022 consultation was found (the only Citizen Space consultation ran July-Aug 2022).

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is the companion 'Quick Checklist' matrix (requirements by application type), not the main 'Local Validation List in detail by Document Type' (DOCX, attach/37771), which sets out what each document must contain and when it applies. The detailed list was not read. The quick checklist is current, but on its own it is incomplete as a source.
issues.evidence: Validation page: 'Local Validation List in detail by Document Type (DOCX 330KB)'; 'Quick Checklist to be read in conjunction with Local Validation List'.

issues.detail: List date 2022-12-01 comes from PDF metadata CreationDate. The council page gives the approval date as 6 March 2023. The list was due for review after two years (March 2025) and no newer version is published, so the 'Outdated (>2y)' flag is correct but should rest on the 6 March 2023 approval date.
issues.evidence: Validation page: local validation list 'approved 6 March 2023'; 'will be reviewed and republished bi-annually'.

issues.detail: The only requirement Grokbot captured, 'Gypsy & Traveller information', is not a requirement. It is a fragment of the table that defines Major development thresholds ('Gypsy/traveller site - 10+ pitches'), run together with column headers and the Application Forms / Ownership certificate / Fees cell text ('Name, contact details, fee').
issues.evidence: Quick checklist: Major thresholds '10+ dwellings / over half a hectare', '1000+ m2 / 1+ hectare', 'Gypsy/traveller site - 10+ pitches'.

issues.detail: The 'Gypsy & Traveller information' fragment is placed under Householder and Change of use - prior approval. Nothing about traveller sites applies to householder applications, and the fragment only matched those types because the column headers 'Planning Enquiry Householder and all other' and 'Prior Approval' appeared in the garbled text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger excerpt: '...Planning Enquiry Householder and all other Name, contact details, fee ... Prior Approval Planning Enquiry Major and Minor Application Forms, Ownership certificate, Fees;'

issues.detail: Householder local requirements in the quick checklist were not captured: Tree Survey/Report (where trees affected); Flood Risk Assessment (if in relevant flood zone); Ecology report / Biodiversity checklist (subject to checklist); Archaeological Assessment (where in area of recognised archaeology); Heritage Statement (where heritage asset affected); Noise/Vibration Assessment (where sensitive noise receptor or generator); Land Contamination Report (where known contamination); CIL Additional Information Form (for new residential or extensions); transport information where parking or access affected. Column alignment in the PDF is flattened, so check each against the original table.
issues.evidence: Quick checklist conditions: 'Where trees affected', 'If in relevant flood zone', 'Where in area of recognised archaeology', 'Where Heritage Asset affected', 'For new residential or extensions'.

issues.detail: Full/Outline (minor and major, residential and commercial), Reserved matters, LBC, Change of use and other rows wrongly say 'national requirements only'. Missed local items include: Affordable Housing Statement (residential); Local Employment and Skills Plan (if Major); Retail Impact Assessment (retail more than 500m outside Winchester town centre); Air Quality Assessment (within 1km of Winchester); Nutrient Neutrality calculations (new residential / overnight accommodation, Habitats Regs 2017 regs 75-79); Solent Recreation Mitigation (new residential); Structural Survey & Conversion Method Statement (residential conversions); Marketing Strategy (loss of employment or service); Masterplan (if part of a large site); Statement of Community Involvement and Viability (major residential); Agricultural Appraisal; LVIA and Landscape Plan (sensitive landscape impact); Drainage Strategy / Foul Drainage form; Sustainability / Climate Change Statement; Planning Obligation Heads of Terms; Waste Management Strategy; CIL form; Biodiversity Net Gain.
issues.evidence: Quick checklist column headings include 'Full or Outline planning application for Major - residential' etc.; conditions such as 'If Major', 'For retail where >500m outside Winch', 'Within 1km of Winch', 'Where loss of employment or service', 'For new residential'.

issues.detail: Winchester's Biodiversity Checklists (one for Householder, one for Other applications) are separate local requirements that the validation page says are mandatory for relevant applications. They are not captured.
issues.evidence: Validation page links 'Biochk-Householder-Editable.pdf' and 'Biochk-Full-Editable.pdf'; completing and submitting the checklist is described as mandatory.

issues.detail: Status 'Captured' / 'Partial (automated)' with Req. items = 1 and empty tab_items overstates coverage. The quick checklist has about 30 conditional local documents across 16 application-type columns (Householder, LBC, Minor/Major residential and commercial, RM, Change of use, Tree works, s73, LDCs, Adverts, Prior Approval, etc.), but Grokbot reports 'national requirements only' for 16 of its 18 application types.
issues.evidence: Quick checklist column headings: 'Householder Planning application', 'Listed Building Consent', 'Full or Outline planning application for Minor - residential', ... 'Prior Approval'.

summary: Grokbot's PDF is the current (approved 6 March 2023) quick checklist, but it is only the companion to the detailed DOCX list, its date comes from file metadata, and its single 'requirement' is a misplaced fragment of the Major-development threshold table. Almost all of Winchester's local requirements (trees, flood, ecology/biodiversity checklist, heritage, archaeology, affordable housing, nutrient neutrality, Solent mitigation, retail impact, air quality, CIL, etc.) were missed. The DOCX could not be read by fetch; the quick-checklist table was read but its flattened columns need manual alignment.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
